comment: Dr. Pribble is a very smart professor who is clearly very passionate about what she teaches. She got me interested in material that I wasn't interested in before. She's a pretty tough grader but participate and show her you care!

Prof. Pribble is a great professor, very knowledgeable but her grading rubrics can be unclear and there's not many grades given. Doesn't post grades online but is always helpful and nice outside of class. Definitely a lot of reading, I recommend you do them or at least know what's going on as midterm/final are consistent with them.

Dr. Pribble is super super nice and very knowledgeable about the course. There are not many grades so you need to preform on the papers if you are not a good test taker. (Two papers, one midterm, one final, one group project.) I would totally take her again! There was reading everyday for class but many people didn't do the reading.

Good prof. Not the easiest grader & lots of readings and assignments due nightly. Her "interactive lecture" style was an interesting approach. Lot of in-class participation, which drives lecture. Graded on 2 papers, 2 exams, participation, and a pretty cool group project on a constitutional rewrite. Definitely knows her stuff, would take again.

Dr. Pribble is extremely knowledgeable in her line of work, and it shows. The lectures may be a little hard to follow if you do not do the reading, but the readings are very interesting and Dr. Pribble is very engaging in class. She is extremely helpful outside of class as well, and has clear grading criteria.

Dr. Pribble is hand-down the most inspirational and dedicated educator I have ever had. She cares deeply about each and every student. Her feedback is unparalleled in its helpfulness, proposed improvements and encouragement. Her teaching style is professional, and her personality is warm and nurturing - in short, she is an amazing professor.
This class was a huge disappointment. I wish that I hadnt taken it. The readings are long and dense and dont really add any value to the discussion or any helpful evidence to the topics.

she's probably the worst professor at ur. she teaches this class like it's a grad school class and grades way too harshly. the readings are so dense and useless that it's clear even she barely understands them. there's an insane amount of reading and none of it is helpful. I left this class learning absolutely nothing. do not believe other reviews.

Dr. Pribble is absolutely amazing! She's so passionate about what she teaches, and it really shows in her lectures and discussions. I have learned so much in this class because her teaching style just really helps it all stick! There is quite a bit of reading, but a lot of it is really interesting, and she also breaks it up with documentaries.

Dr. Pribble is a great polysci professor. Her lectures are really straight forward and you learn a lot. Her papers are a bit tough but she is a very fair grader and also really understanding. She asks good questions for the class and discussions are interesting

Pribble is one of my favorite teachers at Richmond. She really sparked my interest in Latin America and inspired me to study abroad in Chile. Class discussion is interesting. Lots of dense reading. Only take her class if you are interested in the subject. She expects a lot but grades fair and is willing to help!

Don't leave University of Richmond without taking a class from Dr. Pribble. She's the best of the best: organized, engaging, and accessible in and out of class. Her discussions are interesting and relevant. Her papers can be challenging but regardless of your skill coming in, she will teach you how to write better.

Her class is hard and she expects a lot. A ton of reading and you must participate in class. If you ask questions and go to office hours, she is there to help you. If you stay on top of the material and study very hard for the midterm and final, you should be fine. I learned a ton from her, and the class changed my perspective on a lot of things.

she let us pick two readings and their date / country.  we had a field trip to DC.  She sends a lot of e-mails with docs attached.  Discussion is easy and she reviews in class.  In class movies unhelpful.
Wonderful professor. Exceptionally knowledgeable, very helpful, and caring. I learned a lot from her.

Very intelligent woman..willing to help with any question that you have, and will revise your essay before handing it in. A lot of reading, but I learned immense amounts of information while taking this class
Seriously people, you get out what you put into it. Not only is Prof. Pribble a great teacher, but she knows her stuff. I would take her class over any other Latin America class.
She is one of my favorite professors at Richmond.  There was a lot of reading but she was really helpful when I saw her out of class.
great teacher. Easy to talk to. very clear

Professor Pribble is a very good teacher.  Her lectures are boring and there is a lot of reading to do, but she goes over all of it and is willing to answer any questions you may have.  Plus she actually knows the answers because she is a very intelligent woman.

Dr. Pribble is a fantastic teacher! She does require a lot of reading for her classes, but she also goes over all the reading during class and has clear expectations for her students. If you are interested in politics and Latin America, you have to take this class. She's not too difficult of a grader and is phenomenal at mediating class discussions
